pipelines.name: Images

steps.name: Generate Jobs
steps.run:
strategy="$(GITHUB_REPOSITORY=nextcloud "$BASHBREW_SCRIPTS/github-actions/generate.sh")"
strategy="$("$BASHBREW_SCRIPTS/github-actions/munge-i386.sh" -c <<<"$strategy")"
echo "strategy=$strategy" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
jq . <<<"$strategy" # sanity check / debugging aid

steps.name: Summary status
steps.run: if ${{ needs.test.result != 'success' && needs.test.result != 'skipped' }}; then exit 1; fi
